summary: The exact candidate passes its focused processor tests and fixes the reviewed single expanded-image-token span before load_mm_data, but it does not reproduce or explain the original already-visual wrong-landmark response. Its unconditional run collapse also loses cardinality for an independent two-adjacent-placeholder pretokenized boundary case.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: no custom glm5_next processor was registered and sglang.srt.configs.glm5_next_processing was absent.
Nine candidate regressions passed, covering registration, synthetic JPEG preprocessing, resize boundaries, single-run collapse, separated spans, and a mocked pre-load path.
Independent boundary failure: two adjacent pretokenized image placeholders with two image items were collapsed to one placeholder before load_mm_data.

gpu_execution_evidence: Inventory exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2. No GLM inference ran because the exact private weights and JPEG were unavailable; this cannot reproduce an 8x NVIDIA H20 deployment.
remaining_counterexamples: Two adjacent pretokenized GLM-5.3 image placeholders for two image_data items are blindly collapsed to one before load_mm_data.
No exact Statue of Liberty JPEG request was sent through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with GLM-5.3-Flash-sglang0907-128k-0907t3 and checked for landmark semantics.
The candidate does not explain the reported deployment path that already processed visual input but produced unrelated bird semantics.
remaining_limitations: The exact JPEG with SHA-256 ff13fd6f991b37253d3745dc6b9ef8e7a92f17cee7c4c8bc84735000a668fcd7, private GLM-5.3-Flash-sglang0907-128k-0907t3 weights, eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs, CUDA environment, and original deployment were unavailable. The available single AMD MI350X/gfx950 cannot qualify model semantics or the reported distributed architecture. No native source changed, so rebuilding native code was not applicable.
